turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: What brought you in today?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I've just been feeling a bit off over the last week. First I started having like, just a scratchy throat and that was probably I think 5 days ago that happened and then over the last 3 days I've been having diarrhea and also my whole body is just hurting.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and so, when did the sore throat start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I'd say like 5 days ago it started and it first began like kind of a tickle, but now it's more like, even swallowing food hurts a lot.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been eating or drinking less than usual?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, yeah my appetite's been a bit less over the last few days just because of how much it hurts.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you noticed any neck swelling?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no, not really.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how about any redness in the back of your throat?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I checked, I didn't see too much.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, And have there been any changes to your voice?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, a little bit, I wouldn't say too significant.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and muscle aches, like, when did those start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so that started just 3 days ago. I remember waking up and my thighs were hurting, then my upper arms and then it kind of went into my upper back and now it's kind of just general pain in all of the muscles.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, are you having any muscle weakness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, I would say it's mainly pain, I don't really feel weakness.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and how has your energy been? Have you been having fatigue?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I would say, uh, I don't know if it's because of the pain, but I definitely feel a lot more tired.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and you mentioned diarrhea as well. When did that start?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, diarrhea also started around 3 days ago. I normally go 1 or 2 times a day, but now I'm going like 6 or 7 times a day and it's all usually pretty watery.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you noticed any blood in the stool?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't think I noticed blood.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you noticed any, really like, dark or tarry looking stool?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, it's usually just been loose watery stools.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you been experiencing any other symptoms besides the sore throat, muscle aches, fatigue, and diarrhea?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no, I don't think so. Those are probably all of the symptoms.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, so quickly to run through a review. Have you been having any fevers or chills?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I've noticed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, how about any headaches?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had a runny nose?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Have you had a loss of smell or taste?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: I don't think so. I haven't been really eating too much recently, but I don't think so, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had a cough?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Shortness of breath?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: A wheeze?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No wheezing.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, you said you haven't had a cough, but have you brought up any sputum?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any chest pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No chest pain.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Alright, any dizziness or lightheadedness?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Nope.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Any feeling as though your heart is racing.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had any abdominal pain?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, maybe just a little bit with all the diarrhea, I feel like I do have some, Just, tenderness in my abdomen.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh and have you had any nausea or vomiting?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not really.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had any urinary problems?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uhm, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any rashes anywhere?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I've noticed.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you had any changes to your weight recently or over the last several months?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, my weight has been around the same.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and have you been diagnosed with any medical conditions before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I have high blood pressure and high cholesterol.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, do you take any medications for either of those?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so for the cholesterol I'm taking this medication called Crestor. For the high blood pressure I'm taking this medication called Ramipril.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uhm, and do you take any other medications like over the counter or supplements or prescribed?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just multi-vitamins.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you been hospitalized before?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Just, like, in my teens I had my appendix removed but that's it. I have been pretty good otherwise.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, have you had any other surgeries besides the appendix removed?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, that's the only surgery.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and any allergies to medications?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, not that I know of.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and can you tell me a little bit about your living situation?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, so I currently live with my wife and son. We live in a house just in London, and like, I made sure to just isolate myself to one room and I wear a mask around them just in case.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, well that's good. Yeah, it's important to be socially distancing, especially when having symptoms. Has anybody else in that house been sick?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no one has been sick recently, at least in my house, but uh, just two weeks ago I did attend a family event, and just last week I found out, uhm, someone was having symptoms. They just got tested two days ago and their test result hasn't come back.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, I see. And have you traveled anywhere outside of the province or outside of the country?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, it was just here in London, so nothing other than that. I haven't left the province.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and what was the approximate number of people?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: It was just five peaople so we satyed within the limits stated for the city and they were people, in like, my circle as well, so yeah, I don't think I was doing anything wrong.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, just to give an idea of like, risk and contact tracing as well if we need to. And, uh, do you smoke cigarettes?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, I don't smoke.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and do you drink alcohol?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, maybe a one or two beers a week.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and uh, do you use any recreational drugs?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, never.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK. And, uh, in terms of family history, does anybody in the family have any heart or lung conditions?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No, no, not that I know of. I Do you think my brother, my older brother, has high blood pressure.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, nobody's had a heart attack or a stroke?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Uh, no.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Or any cancer in the family?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Oh yeah, cancer, uh, so my father has. It's not the bad skin cancer, it's the one where they can just zap it off.

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, uh, and so, he hasn't needed surgery for it?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: No?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: OK, and I think that's all the questions that I wanted to ask today. Was there anything else that that maybe I forgot to tell you or forgot to ask about?

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: Yeah, I was just wondering, I don't know the results of the contact that I had, uh, so should I also get tested today?

turns.label: Clinician
turns.text: Yeah, certainly with nonspecific symptoms such as what you've been experiencing, we will do a test for covid today. However, we will do some lab investigations as well, because it could be something else, so we'll wait for some of those results to come back, and it's great that you've already taken the initiative to isolate from family members and whatnot. And so I ask you to continue doing so, and we will get back to you when the results are in.

turns.label: Patient
turns.text: OK, yeah, that sounds good, thank you so much.
